name: pchuri-skills
description: Portable Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex CLI, and other tools supporting the open skills standard.

plugins.name: android-reverse-tethering
plugins.description: Share the PC's internet with an Android phone over USB (reverse tethering via gnirehtet) — setup, start/stop, verification, and troubleshooting.

plugins.name: samsung-messages-adb
plugins.description: Read and search text messages on a Samsung Galaxy over adb — SMS, MMS, and RCS (Chat+) — with the store-split and timestamp-unit gotchas that make messages 'invisible' to naive queries.

plugins.name: watchtell
plugins.description: Hand off long-lived watching to the watchtell daemon — describe an alarm in plain language, get a deterministic checker that polls LLM-free and fires only on state transitions. Requires the watchtell CLI (npm i -g watchtell).
